record.question: Which of the following best describes Operation Black Forest carried out in 2025?
options: A high-intensity counterinsurgency mission targeting Maoist strongholds in forested hilly terrains of Chhattisgarh and Telangana.
A long distance bombing of nuclear sites in Iran by the US using stealth bombers.
A clandestine bombing mission by Ukraine using M-52 dones, targeting various Russian military airports and aircrafts.

A night-time operation carried out by the Principal Chief Controller of Forests, Assam where poachers of one horned rhinoceros in the Garbhanga Forest Reserve were traced, tracked and arrested using infra-red cameras.
